limitations: T is the solver shared mixture temperature, not a separately conservative gas temperature.
These fragments specify external reservoir pressure and thermal treatment only; they do not specify a velocity history.
The pair shows sensitivity to boundary treatment, not validated ambient coupling or physical hardware performance.

pressure_fragment.formula: pStatic=p0/(1+0.5*psi*((gamma-1)/gamma)*neg(phi)*|U|^2)^(gamma/(gamma-1)); p_rgh=pStatic-rho*(g.Cf-ghRef). The code obtains psi from registered thermo:psi and uses current rho, U, phi, gravity and hRef.

scope: Public copies of the exact patch-only dictionary fragments used in the completed private pair-r2 compressible-reservoir arm. Insert these blocks under p_rgh.boundaryField and T.boundaryField for the listed external patches only. They are not whole-field replacements and must not replace pressurized tank/internal boundary conditions.

source_api.pressure_conversion_reason: OpenCFD v2512 prghTotalPressure applies an incompressible p0-0.5*rho*U^2 correction; totalPressure has a compressible psi/gamma relation for absolute p, not p_rgh. The tested codedFixedValue uses the compressible isentropic total-to-static relation and then subtracts hydrostatic head.
source_api.registered_psi: psiThermo registers phaseScopedName("thermo","psi"); twoPhaseMixtureThermo corrects it as the phase-fraction weighted psi. With alpha.water=0 at incoming ambient faces, thermo:psi is pure-air psi=1/(R_air*T).
source_api.solver_update_order: In this solver TEqn corrects thermo/mixture before pEqn calls p_rgh.correctBoundaryConditions(); see replay-prep/experiment-v2.json source_api.update_order.

temperature_fragment.formula_and_reversal: Tref=T0/(1+0.5*psi*((gamma-1)/gamma)*neg(phi)*|U|^2); total temperature applies on inflow, zero-gradient treatment on outflow.

tiny_verification.inflow_test_values: 100 kPa back pressure, T0=300 K; verified total-to-static p/T and p_rgh hydrostatic relation.
tiny_verification.qualification: The tiny verification is code/relationship testing only, not hardware or full-solver validation.
tiny_verification.reverse_outflow_test: Verified static pressure and zero-gradient temperature behavior on outflow.
